credits.title: A Free Man
credits.overview: To make a quick buck, a young Quebec worker arrives in Fort McMurray. Obsessed with his ambitions, he finds himself in a difficult situation following a workplace accident.

credits.title: Single on the 25th
credits.overview: After Nell’s family cancels holiday plans at the last minute, she decides to spend the week of Christmas having fun on her own — and crosses paths with her neighbor, who is “happily unattached.”

credits.title: Another Day
credits.overview: A modern man sees his life turn into chaos when a mysterious presence appears.
